proposals.before: Zhang Yanshi was the chief culprit, but he is omitted because he was a minor figure. Delun could have executed him and failed to do so, so Delun alone is made to bear the blame.
proposals.after: Zhang Yan was in fact the chief culprit, but he is omitted because he was a minor figure. Delun could have executed him and failed to do so, so Delun alone is made to bear the blame.
proposals.reason: Chinese 張彥實首惡 uses 實 as “in fact/actually,” not as part of the personal name; the person is 張彥 (Zhang Yan), confirmed by the following 彥，微者.

proposals.before: Zhang Yanshi was the chief culprit, but he is omitted and not written; Yan was a minor man, while Delun could have executed him and did not, so Delun alone is made to bear the responsibility.
proposals.after: Zhang Yan was in fact the chief culprit, but he is omitted and not written; Yan was a minor man, while Delun could have executed him and did not, so Delun alone is made to bear the responsibility.
proposals.reason: Chinese 實 means “actually,” not a name syllable; keep 彥 as Zhang Yan.

proposals.before: In the ninth month of autumn, on the day jiachen, Censor-in-Chief Yao Gui became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.
proposals.after: In the ninth month of autumn, on the day jiachen, Censor-in-Chief Yao Ji became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.
proposals.reason: 姚洎 is standardly read Ji (jì), not Gui.

decisions.reason: Focus unit has 張彥實首惡 then 彥，微者: 實 is the adverb “in fact,” not a name syllable, and the sequel names him 彥 alone. “Zhang Yanshi” invents a wrong personal name; the proposed “Zhang Yan was in fact” matches the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 張彥實首惡，而略不書，彥，微者

decisions.reason: Same misreading in the literal field: 實 is not part of the name 張彥. The replacement correctly renders 張彥實 as “Zhang Yan was in fact” while preserving the rest of the literal wording.
The name in the focus unit is 姚洎; 洎 is read jì, so English “Yao Gui” is a false romanization. Changing only the name to Yao Ji corrects the error without altering the rest of the sentence.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted repair shows the English personal-name value “Yao Gui” was only a bad reading of 姚洎; the person and evidence remain, so the en form is corrected to Yao Ji to match zh/pinyin.
